acceptance_scope: Bounded source/instruction review and implementation behavior; no migration approval, runtime UI result, or user-effectiveness finding.

independent_fixture_results.meaning: Expected declared-field comparisons and input diagnostics matched. Differences are not failures and no differences are not proof of preservation.

supplemental_reproduction.origin: Parent-suggested concrete hypothesis after independent fixtures; independently executed, not independently discovered.

findings.title: Output path can overwrite an input snapshot
findings.symptom: --output が --before と同一パス、または --after を指すsymlinkの場合、入力を比較結果JSONで上書きしてexit 0 / COMPAREDを返す。
basis: Candidate module docstring promises no source mutation.
The output is written with Path.write_text after the source files are read, with no path/object alias check.
Disposable exact-path and symlink reproductions both changed one input's bytes; original independent fixtures were not modified.
findings.impact: 引数の誤指定で比較元または比較先の取得証跡を失い、元snapshotによる再検査ができなくなる。出力のinput_sha256は元のhashを残すだけで、消えた内容を復元できない。
findings.correction: 書込み前にoutputと両入力が同一実体でないことを確認し、同一なら入力を保持したまま非0終了する。正規化された同一路径に加え、存在するpathはsamefile等でsymlink/hardlinkの別名も検査する。エラー出力自体も入力へ書き込まない。通常の別ファイル出力とstdoutのみの利用を維持する。

reproduction.expected: Reject output alias without changing either input.
reproduction.actual: exit 0, status COMPARED, one input overwritten by the result JSON.

non_findings: COMPARED/NOT_EVALUATED and exit 0 do not claim adoption or quality PASS; correct output boundary is explicit.
Legitimate renaming, ID succession, multiple membership, split/merge, and intentional termination are allowed with separate interpretation; no blanket difference-is-defect rule is introduced.
Source truth, whole-inventory completeness, semantic equivalence, authorization, runtime findability, and human effectiveness are explicitly unexamined.
Unknown fields and references outside a partial snapshot are reported, without treating them as proven product defects.
Plan 1.1 contract and validate_plan.py are unchanged versus the frozen baseline; no new required top-level plan field was added.
NISO historical-version limitation, related W3C source family, and SharePoint-specific operation scope are expressly retained.
limitations: The evaluator is an independent thread of the same model family, not an objective human evaluator.

Candidate code, instructions, task-prescribed coverage and researcher source summaries were read before fixture creation. Researcher summaries included proposed test descriptions; parent executable tests, R04 inventory-cases, 96 tasks, rubric/oracle and anonymized proposals were not read before the initial fixtures ran.
No browser rendering or actual UI operation was performed. Prior sandbox-launch restriction was accepted without retry.
No user study, real product inventory migration, tenant operation, or source-data completeness verification occurred.
Parent-reported 68-method suite result is not counted as the reviewer's independent execution.
The source review confirmed bounded original sections, not every claim in every inherited source or a complete source archive.
